card.name: Page and line numbers in citations
card.fires_on: Commas and digits inside bracketed citation markers that give line ranges and page numbers, such as "[57, lines 1-4, p. 239]". Also page numbers in a contents list like "BOOK REVIEW P94".

modes.label: Citation brackets
modes.description: Comma or page digits inside a bracketed reference to lines and pages of a literary work.

modes.label: Contents page numbers
modes.description: Digits after P in a magazine contents list.
modes.example: COMPETITION REPORT P93 BOOK REVIEW P<<9>>4 LOOK AHEAD P96

card.plain: It fires on the numbers and commas in page and line references, like those in a footnote or a contents list.
